# UI Architecture and Visual Consistency Checklist: Location Geofence Guidance

**Purpose**: Review whether the Feature 006 requirements define a complete, clear, consistent, and objectively reviewable mobile Attendance interface, reusable frontend architecture, MobiFone identity, accessibility behavior, and operational state model.
**Created**: 2026-08-20
**Feature**: [Feature 006 specification](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness and Information Hierarchy

- [x] CHK001 Are the mobile-first information priorities stated in an unambiguous order from Location context through the primary Attendance action to secondary diagnostics and spatial guidance? [Completeness, Spec §FR-045]
- [x] CHK002 Is the requirement that the primary Check In or Check Out CTA precede technical diagnostics and spatial guidance explicit enough to resolve competing layout choices? [Clarity, Spec §FR-046]
- [x] CHK003 Are the required headline, CTA, and processing labels defined separately for no-open-session and open-session states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-046]
- [x] CHK004 Does the default-view requirement identify exactly which actionable GPS information is visible without exposing latitude, longitude, or other technical diagnostics at equal priority? [Clarity, Spec §FR-047]
- [x] CHK005 Is GPS readiness required to combine the numeric accuracy, Attendance threshold, textual meaning, and a non-color cue so that raw coordinates are unnecessary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-050–FR-051]
- [x] CHK006 Are nearby Location rows required to present name/code, address, distance, radius where relevant, containment, nearest, and focused-target meanings as one scannable unit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §FR-048]
- [x] CHK007 Are coincident and overlapping Location requirements explicit that each candidate remains distinguishable and that nearest, containing, focused, and server-selected meanings are not conflated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022–FR-024, §FR-048]
- [x] CHK008 Is the spatial view explicitly secondary by default on constrained screens and ordered after the primary Attendance action and textual Location information? [Clarity, Spec §FR-049, §FR-063]

## Reusable Architecture and Ownership

- [x] CHK009 Does the requirements set define one reusable application shell boundary covering header, page context, account access, content container, safe areas, and responsive navigation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-054]
- [x] CHK010 Is duplication of header and primary-navigation structures explicitly prohibited across employee pages, with one shared navigation source required? [Clarity, Spec §FR-054, §FR-056]
- [x] CHK011 Are capability filtering and route availability distinguished from authorization enforcement so the shared shell cannot become a second access-control authority? [Consistency, Spec §FR-037a, §FR-056; Constitution §III]
- [x] CHK012 Are the reuse expectations for Button, Card, Badge, SectionHeading, and asynchronous-state primitives specific enough to prevent feature-local near-duplicates? [Completeness, Spec §FR-064; Frontend UI Contract §2]
- [x] CHK013 Is the decision not to generalize Dialog or Sheet justified by an explicit reuse threshold rather than by an accidental omission? [Clarity, Spec §FR-064; Frontend UI Contract §2]
- [x] CHK014 Are browser/API state, guidance view state, presentation, and authoritative Attendance decisions separated clearly enough that GPS status cannot calculate punch eligibility? [Consistency, Spec §FR-051, §FR-066]
- [x] CHK015 Is the spatial implementation boundary defined independently of Attendance command logic while remaining consistent with the prohibition on external map SDKs, tiles, and provider abstractions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025–FR-029a; Plan §Structure Decision]
- [x] CHK016 Does the specification define which Nearby Location presentation responsibilities are reusable by future Task Evidence and which Attendance-specific threshold, selection, and command semantics must remain excluded? [Gap, Reusability]
- [x] CHK017 Are component ownership and abstraction criteria clear enough to prevent both a monolithic Attendance/guidance component and one-off micro-components without a stable responsibility? [Clarity, Spec §FR-064–FR-066]

## MobiFone Brand and Visual Tokens

- [x] CHK018 Does the requirements set mandate one approved local MobiFone asset and prohibit arbitrary remote, duplicated, improvised, or repeated inline substitutes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-055; Frontend UI Contract §4]
- [x] CHK019 Are logo aspect ratio, no-crop/no-stretch behavior, intrinsic sizing, clear space, and meaningful alternative text all specified as acceptance requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-055; Frontend UI Contract §4]
- [x] CHK020 Is the intended behavior when the approved logo asset or its provenance is unavailable documented without weakening the brand acceptance gate? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases; Frontend UI Contract §4]
- [x] CHK021 Are MobiFone blue, critical red, success/ready green, and neutral surface meanings assigned to centralized semantic tokens rather than page-specific raw colors? [Consistency, Spec §FR-057]
- [x] CHK022 Are error, overdue, critical, success, and ready meanings defined consistently enough to prevent the same semantic color from communicating conflicting states? [Clarity, Spec §FR-057, §FR-061]
- [x] CHK023 Are card boundaries, restrained depth, rounding, spacing, and decorative restraint defined in relation to mobile usability and hierarchy rather than pixel-perfect imitation of the reference? [Consistency, Spec §FR-058, §FR-067]

## Responsive and Accessibility Requirements

- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined separately for 320–375 px phones and approximately 390–430 px phones while preserving one task order and single-column behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-059]
- [x] CHK025 Are tablet and desktop adaptations bounded to at most two content regions with unchanged semantic reading order, CTA priority, and centered readable width? [Clarity, Spec §FR-059]
- [x] CHK026 Are safe-area, wrapping, and no-overflow expectations defined for display cutouts, home indicators, long addresses, translated text, and narrow screens? [Coverage, Spec §FR-054, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK027 Is the minimum acceptable touch-target size objectively specified for primary, refresh, disclosure, navigation, and Location-selection controls? [Measurability, Frontend UI Contract §8]
- [x] CHK028 Are visible focus, logical focus order, accessible names, and full keyboard operation required for every interactive control and disclosure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-060]
- [x] CHK029 Are text, icon/shape, and numeric alternatives required wherever color communicates readiness, error, selection, nearest, containment, or overlap? [Completeness, Spec §FR-061]
- [x] CHK030 Are Location identity, address, distance, radius, and relationship requirements preserved as a textual alternative independent of the spatial view? [Completeness, Spec §FR-063]
- [x] CHK031 Are assistive-technology requirements defined for meaningful loading, refreshing, stale, success, and failure transitions without repeatedly announcing the ticking sample age? [Clarity, Spec §FR-062; Frontend UI Contract §7]
- [x] CHK032 Are reduced-motion and sufficient-contrast requirements stated for every decorative animation and semantic foreground/background pairing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-061–FR-062]

## Operational State and Recovery Coverage

- [x] CHK033 Are idle, acquiring GPS, refreshing, and fresh/ready states each assigned distinct required content, status semantics, stable layout behavior, and available actions? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §FR-052–FR-053 state table]
- [x] CHK034 Are weak-GPS and outside-radius requirements defined as independent states with separate numeric evidence, terminology, remediation, and no preview-based CTA gating? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, §FR-020, §FR-052 state table]
- [x] CHK035 Are multiple-candidate and overlapping-Location requirements complete for visual distinction, default visual focus, explicit focus override, and authoritative server selection? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §FR-022–FR-024, §FR-052 state table]
- [x] CHK036 Are permission-denied, geolocation-unavailable, and timeout states specified with mutually exclusive wording and distinct settings, retry, or refresh recovery paths? [Exception Coverage, Spec §FR-006–FR-008b, §FR-052 state table]
- [x] CHK037 Is stale preview distinguished from fresh GPS through text, age, and non-color treatment while retaining readable values and explaining that Attendance acquires a new sample? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-052 state table]
- [x] CHK038 Are Attendance submitting, success, and business-rejection states specified separately with action-specific labels, persistence duration, authoritative wording, next steps, retry behavior, and stable CTA-adjacent placement? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §FR-046, §FR-053 state table]
- [x] CHK039 Are reference-data loading/failure and unknown GPS acquisition failure included without collapsing them into an empty normal screen or a generic Attendance rejection? [Exception Coverage, Spec §FR-008a–FR-008b, §FR-021a, §FR-052–FR-053]

## Acceptance Criteria and Cross-Artifact Consistency

- [x] CHK040 Can hierarchy, progressive disclosure, state distinction, responsive behavior, accessibility, component ownership, and brand-token requirements be reviewed semantically without relying on exact screenshot pixels or subjective terms such as “prominent” alone? [Measurability, Spec §FR-045–FR-067; Frontend UI Contract §8]
